article.title: Kunstnike liidu toetusoksjon jätkub reedel
article.text:
EKO juhatuse liikme Andres Veske sõnul tekkis tõrge EKO oksjonirakenduses. Esialgne kahtlus küberrünnakule kinnitust ei leidnud. Tõrke põhjustas oksjonikeskkonna erakordselt suur koormus, kuigi korraldajad olid suureks huviks valmistunud, ei pidanud üks osa oksjonirakendusest koormusele vastu. Zone'i poolt pakutav serveriteenus toimis tõrgeteta. 

"Vabandame kõigi kunstihuviliste ees. Oleme eilsest õhtust peale tegelenud rikke põhjuse väljaselgitamisega ja kaasanud eksperte, et oksjonikeskkond peaks koormusele vastu. Leidsime tõrke põhjuse, parandasime selle ja testisime süsteemi põhjalikult," ütles Veske. 

"Saime neljapäeval esimese töö müüdud, kui algasid tõrked oskjonikeskkonnas. Me alguses ei teadnud ju, miks ta ei tööta. Siis arvasime, et on küberrünnak. Pärast selgus, et pole. Tõrke põhjustas hoopis üks rakenduse osa, mis oli meie enda oma," sõnas Veske.

"Oleme kaasanud eksperte mitmest kohast, ka riiklikul tasemel. Oleme keskkonda testinud ja kõik töötab tõrgeteta," lisas Veske. "Ükski meie eelnev oksjon pole selliseid tõrkeid kogenud. Nüüd, kus me võimendasime tulemüüre ja turvalisust, oli see meie rakenduse jaoks liig. See on kahetstsväärne ja me vabandame kõigi ees, kes ei saanud neljapäeval pakkumist teha," lausus ta.

Kuna tehnilise tõrke tõttu ei pruukinud kõik pakkumised süsteemi jõuda või tehtud pakkumised võisid kustuda, palutakse kõigil oksjonikeskkonnas enda pakkumised üle kontrollida ja vajadusel pakkumised uuesti teha. See puudutab nii tava- kui ka automaatpakkumisi.

Neljapäevasel oksjonil müüdi üks teos, Jüri Arraku "Tiiger". EKO esindaja ja oksjoni läbiviija Reigo Kuivjõgi sõnul on ostjaga ühendust võetud ja alustatud tavapäraste müügidetailide täpsustamist. 

"Töö müüdi kõrge hinnaga. Ostja oli päris inimene, mitte võtlskonto," lisas Veske.

Reedel jätkub oksjon Arraku teosega "Mängud ümber puu" (1. päev, 2. teos) ja kestab kuni Viktor Karruse teoseni "Legend" (2. päev, 26. teos). Laupäevane oksjon algab kell 15 Flo Kasearu teosega "Homne on seljas" (2. päev 27. teos).

"On äärmiselt kahetsusväärne, et EKO oksjonikeskkond ei pidanud vastu. Suurt huvi me ootasime, kuid tehniline tõrge oli ebameeldiv üllatus. Oleme saanud oksjoni korraldajalt kinnituse, et oksjonikeskkond on parandatud ja testitud," ütles EKLi president Maarin Ektermann.

Oksjon toimub reedel ja laupäeval ARS-i kunstilinnakus (Pärnu mnt 154, Tallinn). Saal avatakse kell 17. Oksjonil saab osaleda ka veebis aadressil eestikunstioksjonid.ee. Oksjoni viib läbi Reigo Kuivjõgi Eesti Kunsti Oksjonitest.

Eesti Kunstnike Liit korraldab erakorralise kunstioksjoni, kus läheb müüki 162 teost. Oksjoni eesmärk on katta ligi 700 000 euro suurune kahju, mis tekkis liidule kevadel kelmuse tagajärjel.

plan.visionAnalysis: The news photograph shows a well-lit modern art gallery wall with various paintings and sculptures displayed in a clean, orderly manner. The artworks range from abstract to figurative, with a mix of colors and styles. There are no people visible in the image. The setting is a calm indoor space with neutral walls and minimal distractions, focusing attention on the displayed art pieces. The photograph is a straightforward documentation of the exhibition space, not a logo, stock photo or illustration.
articleFacts: Eesti Kunstnike Liit (Estonian Artists' Union) is organizing an extraordinary art auction to recover nearly 700,000 euros of loss caused by fraud earlier this year.
The auction platform experienced a technical failure due to extremely high load, initially suspected as a cyberattack but later confirmed to be a failure in one part of their own auction application.
Experts including state-level ones were involved to identify and fix the problem; the system was tested thoroughly and now works without errors.
On Thursday, only one artwork was sold before the technical issues started.
Buyers are asked to check their bids and re-submit if necessary, as some bids may have been lost or not registered due to the glitch.
The auction continues on Friday and Saturday at ARS Art Complex in Tallinn, with both physical and online participation.
The auction features 162 artworks, including works by Jüri Arrak and Viktor Karrus.
The auction is important for the union's financial recovery and has attracted significant interest, but the technical failure was an unfortunate surprise.
The photograph shows the art exhibition space with various artworks arranged on a white wall and pedestals, corresponding to the auction setting.
plan.storyPremise: An extraordinary art auction by the Estonian Artists' Union faces a critical technical failure due to overwhelming demand, threatening the event's success and the union's financial recovery. Experts intervene to resolve the problem, restore trust, and enable continuation of the auction both online and in person, highlighting the tension between cultural value, technological vulnerability, and human dedication in crisis.

scenes.title: The Technical Breakdown and Expert Intervention
scenes.storyBeat: The first scene depicts the moment when the auction system fails under heavy load. Abstract cubist figures represent the organizers and experts analyzing the problem, surrounded by fractured digital motifs symbolizing the glitch and data flow. The tension between human effort and technological failure is central. The setting is a darkened abstract control room blending with the auction environment.
scenes.videoPrompt: The scene opens with fractured cubist figures gathered around abstract digital panels flickering with glitch patterns. The main figure representing the organizer gestures urgently, while others point to broken data streams. The glitch motifs pulse and distort, then experts start stabilizing the digital shapes as the tension eases slightly by the end.
scenes.selectionReason: The 'Auge / Glühbirne' figure symbolizes technical modernity, observation, and the ambivalence of technology, fitting the theme of a system failure and expert investigation.
scenes.stillPrompt: A dark, abstract cubist mural depicting a tense control room where fractured, mask-like figures with angular faces and elongated limbs gather around glowing, broken digital panels emitting fractured light and glitch patterns. The figures' faces show concern and concentrated effort, their hands pointing and gesturing toward the flickering screens. Jagged, intersecting planes of stained ivory and ash gray form the room, with charcoal-black shadows emphasizing technological tension. The fractured digital motifs float and overlap with the figures, blending human and machine. Reference image 1 shows the auction exhibition's calm gallery wall, reimagined here as an abstract control space with fragmented light. Reference image 2 is the cubist 'Auge / Glühbirne' figure, redrawn as a central expert figure with a glowing eye, integrated into the scene's fractured digital environment. One continuous dirty cubist mural: faces, hands, bodies, clothing and surroundings share the same aggressively fractured angular planes, coarse charcoal marks, scratched pigment and rough dry-brush texture on aged cracked plaster. Faces are displaced asymmetrical masks; skin is stained ivory and ash-gray paint. Flatten all anatomy into broken painted planes, with the same abstraction and brushstroke scale throughout the sequence. Deep soot black, ash gray and stained ivory bind every figure to its setting.

scenes.title: The Auction Resumes with Caution
scenes.storyBeat: This scene captures the cautious resumption of the auction, with fractured cubist figures representing auctioneers and bidders interacting with a fragmented digital interface symbolizing the repaired system. The atmosphere is still tense but hopeful, with visual motifs of protective barriers and renewed connectivity.
scenes.videoPrompt: The scene begins with a fractured auctioneer figure raising a hand to signal resumption. Digital shards reassemble into clearer forms representing restored connectivity. Bidders appear as fragmented figures cautiously engaging with the interface. The digital environment stabilizes, reflecting growing confidence by the end.
scenes.selectionReason: The 'Frau mit Lampe' figure, symbolizing hope, truth, and guidance, suits the theme of renewed trust and careful continuation of the auction.
